name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog:
Fixes the plugin reporting itself as v0.0.77 in the Jellyfin dashboard regardless of which version was actually installed. Root cause: the csproj's AssemblyVersion/FileVersion were left at 0.0.77 for the 0.0.78 and 0.0.79 releases - Jellyfin reads a plugin's displayed version from the compiled assembly, not from meta.json, so both releases shipped correct manifest metadata around a DLL that still self-identified as 0.0.77 internally. No functional change; this release only corrects the version stamp embedded in the build.

220 tests.
